TFC.full_name: Tight/ellipse-exact tile footprint (EWA projected-ellipse footprint tightening)
TFC.hypothesis: Current EWA projected-ellipse bounding boxes (per-axis AABB) generate unnecessary tile intersections; an ellipse-exact / tighter footprint removes intersections with no image degradation.

oracle_status.note: TFC0 (CPU/analytic oracle) certified Strategy A removes 42.41% of tile intersections bit-exact. TFC2 (real A100 kernel) CONFIRMED the ellipse-exact footprint removes 38.2% pooled intersections.

TFC.implementation_detail: Independent kernel tfc2_ablation.cu (3 modes: circular/axis-AABB/ellipse) on EPIC-05 A100; TFC1 rowwise kernel kept byte-identical and NOT imported by TFC2.
TFC.hardware_cohort: EPIC-05 A100-SXM4-80GB, remote-only (no local CUDA); gsplat 1.5.3 fork gsplat-b1-clean-v153; CUDA 12.8, torch 2.9.1+cu128; tile_size=16, eps2d=0.3, SH=3.

full_convergence_evidence.note: Renderer-local microbench on FROZEN trained PLYs (single forward+backward pass per camera). No 30K full-training convergence run. Do NOT present as training speedup.

psnr_ssim_lpips.note: Renders pixel-identical: max dPSNR 2.59e-07 dB across 88 cameras; SSIM/LPIPS deltas <1e-6. Per-camera PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS present in TFC2_BENCHMARK.json.

gradient_correctness.note: min grad-cosine 0.999954 (train). Self-imposed proxy gate grad_cosine>=0.99999 FAILS but proven by 6-run determinism analysis to sit at the CUDA atomic-add noise floor (stdev 1.8e-5 > gate gap 7.3e-6), not a correctness regression. PSNR pixel-identical.

forward_pipeline_speedup.value: intersect kernel 1.38x faster; per-scene fwd render 1.15-1.42x

full_training_step_speedup.note: Renderer-local only; no full-training-step measurement. MUST NOT be converted from renderer speedup.

K50-B1.full_name: Densification-safe predictive sparse backward (skip gradient computation for bottom-50% by previous-gradient norm)
K50-B1.hypothesis: Skipping ALL gradient computation for masked (low previous-iteration gradient-norm) Gaussians inside the CUDA backward kernel accelerates the training step while preserving quality and densification.

oracle_status.verdict: C51-R simulation oracle -> Stage 4A/4B real CUDA
oracle_status.note: C51-R simulated sparse backward then masked gradients in Python. Stage 4A/4B implement the mask inside RasterizeToPixels3DGSBwd.cu (real CUDA).

K50-B1.implementation_detail: 6 gsplat 1.5.3 files patched (RasterizeToPixels3DGSBwd.cu mask branch do_full_grad/do_densify_only/skip; Rasterization.h/.cpp, Ops.h, _wrapper.py, rendering.py). importance_mask uniform across warp (no divergence).

hardware_cohort.note: STAGE4A and STAGE4B ARE SEPARATE COHORTS. Never merge their numbers.

DFC.full_name: Per-pixel transmittance early-termination (DFC1-R2 adaptive threshold) + DFC1-R1 saved-T backward fix
DFC.hypothesis: Many pixels reach sufficient opacity that subsequent Gaussian contribution ~0 (transmittance T->0); a per-pixel transmittance threshold can safely stop compositing and skip splats. Separately, the saved-T backward fix corrects catastrophic gradient cancellation in the full-render (T->0) regime.

oracle_status.verdict: DFC0_PASS_EARLY_TERMINATION_HEADROOM -> DFC1_R1 backward fix ADOPT -> DFC1_R2_ADAPTIVE FAIL_CLOSED -> DFC2_GENERALIZATION (amended quality-only gate) UNIVERSAL_QUALITY_PASS but NO training-step speedup (production_full_training_step=NOT_MEASURED)
oracle_status.note: DFC0 oracle certified headroom. DFC1-R1 validated the saved-T backward fix (ADOPT_DFC1R1_SAVED_T_BACKWARD). DFC1-R2 adaptive-threshold pack is FAIL_CLOSED (DROP_NO_TERMINATION_HEADROOM on dense scenes). DFC2_GENERALIZATION_PACK (POST_PBR0_H1 amendment: gate changed to quality-only, 10% workload floor removed) reaches UNIVERSAL_QUALITY_PASS (dPSNR<=0.05dB on all 6 held-out MipNeRF360 scenes at t=1e-07 and 1e-06) but with negligible renderer speedup (min fwd-pipe ~1.0007x, splat reduction ~6-8%) and production_full_training_step=NOT_MEASURED; the amended verdict does NOT change the method-level DROP role (no usable full-training-step speedup). Historical pre-amendment DFC2 verdict (FAIL_CLOSED with workload floor) preserved in source.

VOS.full_name: Visibility-aware optimizer scheduling (skip updates for invisible/cold Gaussians)
VOS.hypothesis: Invisible (radii=0) Gaussians carry near-zero position-gradient, so skipping their optimizer updates reduces workload with no quality loss.

oracle_status.VOS0: KEEP (SH-only virtual optimizer state, active iters 15001-30000)
oracle_status.VOS1_hardened: QUALITY_FAIL (device-side compaction, corrected unseen true-holdout eval, 3 seeds, same-15K-prefix fork)

VOS.implementation_detail: No custom CUDA kernel. SparseGaussianAdam (pure-PyTorch active-subset Adam); VOS1 adds device-side compaction to remove per-step torch.nonzero host syncs. FasterGSFused backend, seed 42, 30000 iters, graphdeco pipeline.
VOS.hardware_cohort: A100 (EPIC-05 remote for VOS1 hardened); FasterGSFused C0; graphdeco pipeline; 3 seeds {0,1,42}; 18 runs (3 scenes x 2 schedulers x 3 seeds) x 30000 iters.

full_convergence_evidence.note: Full 30K training, 3 seeds, 2 schedulers (k=1 baseline, k=2 VOS). VOS1 hardened uses corrected unseen true-holdout eval, same-15K-prefix fork, in-process replay oracle vs single-tensor Adam A_s.

IGF.full_name: Importance-guided sparse Adam freezing (freeze low-importance Gaussians in optimizer)
IGF.hypothesis: Under importance model I3 (mean2D-absgrad x visible_ratio x contribution), importance-ranked freezing of low-importance Gaussians cuts optimizer-update workload with negligible quality loss.

IGF.implementation_detail: No custom CUDA kernel. SparseAdam = pure-PyTorch active-subset Adam; inactive rows bit-frozen; active rows bit-identical math to torch.optim.Adam. FasterGSFused (C0), seed 42, 30000 iters.
IGF.hardware_cohort: A100 (EPIC-05 remote); FasterGSFused C0; warmup 0..15000 dense (densify_until_iter=15000), scheduled phase 15000..30000 (population frozen); room/garden/bicycle.

CGC.full_name: Contribution-aware Gaussian culling (drop low-contribution (tile,Gaussian) candidates at emission)
CGC.hypothesis: A significant fraction of Gaussian-tile intersections are evaluated by raster kernels but contribute negligible pixel gradients/color; culling them at emission preserves quality while cutting candidates.

oracle_status.CGC0: CGC0_CANDIDATE (CPU oracle: wasted_candidate_ratio 0.542, combined-oracle reduction 0.519, Amdahl upper 2.054, PSNR loss 1.06e-4 dB)

CGC.implementation_detail: CGC1 patched IntersectTile.cu (candidate emission): drop (tile,Gaussian) when peak_alpha=min(0.999,opac*exp(-sigma_min))<threshold. Both passes. rendering.py reads CGC1_CULL_THRESHOLD env (<=0 disables = byte-identical baseline).
CGC.hardware_cohort: EPIC-05 A100-SXM4-80GB, gsplat 1.5.3 (git 937e299, frozen /root/epic05_frozen/gsplat-b1-clean-v153), torch 2.9.1+cu128, CUDA 12.8; tile_size=16, sh_degree=3, seed 42; CUDA events WARMUP=3 ITERS=10 median.

KFC.full_name: Kernel fusion (fuse rasterize_fwd + gradient_preparation bwd attribute-fetch)
KFC.hypothesis: Fusing forward and backward per-tile so the backward reuses the forward shared-memory fetch of per-isect attributes (means2d/conics/colors/opacities) eliminates redundant global memory traffic and yields speedup.

oracle_status.KFC0: KFC0_CANDIDATE (oracle: C3 eliminates 1437 MB = 25.0% pipeline / 62.78% 4-kernel traffic, Amdahl E2E upper 1.48x - but based on overcounted 1.51GB DRAM)

KFC.implementation_detail: KFC1 added rasterize_fused_fwd_bwd.cu (declared bindings.h:493, bound ext.cpp:41). Per-tile block loads all isect attrs into shared memory once, runs forward alpha-blend then backward gradient reusing the fetch, replicating warpSum reduction before atomicAdd. Compiled 0 errors, symbol present for CDIM 1/3/4. Fixed 3 bugs (warpSum template args, early-termination last_ids semantics, device-pointer deref for max_isects).
KFC.hardware_cohort: A100-SXM4-80GB, gsplat 1.5.3 (EPIC-05 canonical, repo SHA abfa6c3e), torch 2.10.0+cu128, CUDA 12.8; room_iter10000, 1920x1080, tile_size=32.

full_convergence_evidence.note: Kernel microbenchmark on a single frozen trained checkpoint (room_iter10000). No 30K convergence run.

psnr_ssim_lpips.note: Math identical to baseline on launchable workloads: relL2 ~5-7e-08 (<=1e-6), cosine >=0.999999, zero NaN, CDIM in {1,3,4}. No image-quality (PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS) claim.

gradient_correctness.note: On all launchable workloads: relL2 ~6e-08 <=1e-6, cosine >=0.999999, zero NaN. Real room workload cannot launch (shared-memory overflow).

workload_reduction.note: 50% analytical attribute-traffic reduction on paper, but KFC0's 1.51GB 'DRAM' is an overcount: attrs for N=1,004,935 is ~36.4MB, fits A100 40MB L2 (re-read is L2-served, not DRAM). 50% traffic reduction yields <1.0x speedup.

forward_pipeline_speedup.note: Best launchable fused speedup 0.98x < 1.2x requirement. Real room workload cannot launch (804KB shared >> 164KB A100 max).

forward_backward_speedup.note: Fused fwd+bwd SLOWER (best 0.98x) on launchable workloads. bwd is compute-bound (flat 102.03->102.83ms for N 100K->2M, <1% change for 20x more Gaussians).

full_training_step_speedup.note: P4 E2E training NOT RUN: autograd boundary (loss between fwd and bwd in Python) prevents single-launch fusion without moving loss into kernel (forbidden).

provenance_source_lock_quality.note: KFC1_SOURCE_LOCK.json (frozen gsplat 1.5.3, matches KFC0) + remote_identity.json (hostname/GPU/CUDA/torch/repo SHA/working dir). KFC0 verdict + KFC1 evidence (correctness/kernel-timing/memory-profile/e2e/resource).

KFC0's 1.51GB DRAM traffic prediction disproven (L2-resident)

AGS.full_name: Adaptive/incremental Gaussian tile sorting (repair previous-iteration tile order instead of radix sort)
AGS.hypothesis: Previous-iteration tile depth ordering can be repaired incrementally instead of rebuilding the CUB radix sort every iteration.

AGS.implementation_detail: AGS1 captured REAL gsplat sort I/O for 12 consecutive COLMAP room cameras through frozen ckpt (projection+intersect+CUB radix). Baseline A = cub::DeviceRadixSort::SortPairs over 48 bits. Incremental B = per-tile repair seeded from O_prev (count_tiles -> ExclusiveSum(offsets) -> scatter -> per-tile bitonic sort keyed by composite(depth_id,flatten_id)) with prev-segment reuse check (splitmix hash).
AGS.hardware_cohort: EPIC-05 A100-SXM4-80GB (dsw-933622-64cc845c7d-lqswc), CUDA 12.8, torch 2.9.1+cu128, repo abfa6c3e, gsplat fork b1-clean-v153; scene=room, frozen ckpt m3_sh3_step30000.pt (N_sub=704,726, sh_degree=3).
AGS.camera_count: 12 consecutive COLMAP room cameras (sort I/O captured); garden/bicycle frozen step30000 checkpoints MISSING on EPIC-05 (only room m3_sh3 exists).

full_convergence_evidence.note: Microbenchmark on a single frozen step30000 checkpoint (room). No 30K convergence run.

psnr_ssim_lpips.note: Sort-stage method; correctness is bit-exactness vs CUB radix, not image quality. Incremental repair == CUB radix bit-exactly on isect_ids/flatten_ids/offsets for all 11 consecutive frame pairs (Phase2 ALL_OK=True).

gradient_correctness.note: Not a gradient method; sort-order correctness verified bit-exact (all 15,848 tie runs strictly ascending).

workload_reduction.note: Reuse 0% across all temporal gaps (1-10); 0/25350 tiles reusable; 0% of persistent (flatten,tile) elements keep depth-order. Tile-membership Jaccard ~0.001. Nothing to repair.

forward_pipeline_speedup.note: Sort-stage speedup B/A=0.460x (noReuse); incremental repair 2.18x SLOWER than radix (requirement >=2.0x).

forward_backward_speedup.note: Phase 4 E2E NOT REACHED (Phase 3 failed). Sort stage = 0.69ms = 29.9% of upstream, 13.9% of forward pass; even a hypothetical 2x sort gain saves only ~7% of forward (<5% E2E gate).
